description:
Earth had nuclear reactors roughly 2 billion years ago. Nobody built them.

At Oklo, in today's Gabon, uranium, rock and groundwater sustained fission naturally. Heat, not electricity.

Original illustrations and AI-generated narration.

#Oklo #NuclearPhysics #Geology
firstComment: Groundwater wasn't the fuel. Collisions with hydrogen slowed neutrons, helping them split more uranium. The uranium in the rock supplied the fuel.
